channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Luke Kennard | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Luke Kennard from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jordan Ott on Luke Kennard
item.description:
Jordan Ott on Luke Kennard:

“There are very few movement shooters in the NBA. It feels like they are going away and he can do it. And I think he has more playmaking ability. We saw it there at the end of the last season, the playmaking ability of him. He is another guy defensively we are going to ask to probably do something he has not done, try to stretch him there to take the ball, like we talk about a lot. Just knowing him and how he approaches it, he is one of those routine, consistent, and the shooting piece is as real as I have ever seen.”

Jordan Ott on Luke Kennard, Oct 4, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Deandre Ayton on Luke Kennard
item.description:
Deandre Ayton on Luke Kennard:

“He is the number one shooter in the NBA so, you know, there's not much to say but, you know, he's doing it in the playoffs where it really counts. My word is speechless to be honest.”

Deandre Ayton on Luke Kennard, Apr 19, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: LeBron James on Marcus Smart, Deandre Ayton, Luke Kennard, Jake LaRavia
item.description:
“Because this is a new group. We added [Deandre Ayton], Marcus [Smart] and Jake [LaRavia] and we just got a new acquisition on our ballclub a couple games ago [in Luke Kennard]. So, it's too hard to really say what we're capable of.”

LeBron James on Marcus Smart, Deandre Ayton, Luke Kennard, Jake LaRavia, Feb 15, 2026. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Shaedon Sharpe on Luke Kennard
item.description:
Shaedon Sharpe on the block of Luke Kennard's 3-point attempt to send the game to overtime:

“I won't lie, I don't even know how I blocked it. I lost [Kennard], and then I saw the ball go that way and I just jumped. I saw it and I reacted.”

Shaedon Sharpe on Luke Kennard, Nov 4, 2023. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Xavier Tillman on Luke Kennard
item.description:
Xavier Tillman on Luke Kennard:

“Luke brings a lot of floor spacing to our game and he can shoot it at a high clip. The medical staff is working with him. Hopefully we can get him back as soon as possible.”

Xavier Tillman on Luke Kennard, Apr 28, 2023. Source: Twitter @DrewHill_DM.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Luke Kennard
item.description:
Law Murray:Lue on Kennard:

“It's tough when you lose the #1 3-point shooting guy in the league. You definitely don't want to see anyone get injured. But it's been our mentality all year. A guy goes down, other guys got to step up. ... No excuses, got to get ready to play.”

Tyronn Lue on Luke Kennard, Apr 12, 2022. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: Jacqueline Towns on Luke Kennard
item.description:
“I told Luke Kennard I wanted to go first, so I was glad when they called my name and that I was gonna go first,”

Jacqueline Towns on Luke Kennard, Feb 20, 2022. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Paul George, Nicolas Batum, Kawhi Leonard, Marcus Morris, Luke Kennard, Terance Mann
item.description:
Eric Walden:Quin Snyder, on the Clippers:

“Because [Leonard and George are] such great players, there’s some tendency not to talk about other guys on their team— guys like Mann coming in, what Morris did today, Kennard, the defense that Batum played.”

Quin Snyder on Paul George, Nicolas Batum, Kawhi Leonard, Marcus Morris, Luke Kennard, Terance Mann, Jun 6, 2021. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Luke Kennard
item.description:
James Edwards III:Dwane Casey:

“Luke Kennard came in here in great shape. He accomplished and we accomplished with what we wanted to do with him. No tendinitis. I think he's in the best shape since I've coached him. He played with intelligence and confidence.”

Dwane Casey on Luke Kennard, Oct 2, 2020. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Ed Stefanski on Luke Kennard
item.description:
#Pistons Stefanski on Luke Kennard:

“People wanted him traded at the deadline. Luke is terrific. Arguably, Luke was our best player in the series vs. MIL. He’s only two years in.”

Ed Stefanski on Luke Kennard, Jun 17, 2019. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Luke Kennard
item.description:
#Bucks coachMike Budenholzer on Luke Kennard's contributions in #Pistons offense:

“What Luke did in the first two games is very present with us.”

Mike Budenholzer on Luke Kennard, Apr 22, 2019. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Luke Kennard
item.description:
James Edwards III:Dwane Casey:

“Luke Kennard is really growing up right in front of us. ... You know you have respect when teams are double-teaming you. They're blitzing his pick-and-rolls.”

Dwane Casey on Luke Kennard, Mar 10, 2019. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Luke Kennard
item.description:
James Edwards III:Dwane Casey:

“(Luke Kennard) is probably our second best, third best playmaker,when talking about making plays for others.”

Dwane Casey on Luke Kennard, Jan 18, 2019. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Luke Kennard
item.description:
#Pistons Dwane Casey on Luke Kennard's knee injury:

“I wouldn’t say it’s a total setback. That’s what the Summer League was for -- to see him and Henry get acclimated to what we want them to be offensively.”

Dwane Casey on Luke Kennard, Jul 5, 2018. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.
